get.description: Returns the configuration settings for the tenant account. Use the optional `fields` query parameter to control which sections of the configuration are returned. By default (`minimal`), only a small set of identifiers and legal links are returned. Use `all` to fetch the full configuration, or supply a comma separated list of top-level field names to fetch a custom subset.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description:
Controls which sections of the account configuration are included in the response.
- `minimal` (default): returns a small, lightweight set of fields (`appName`, `termsOfService`, `privacyPolicy`).
- `all`: returns every supported configuration field.
- Comma separated list of supported top-level field names to return only those fields.

Supported field names (for comma separated usage):
- `appName`
- `termsOfService`
- `privacyPolicy`
- `languages`
- `autoGovernance`
- `people`
- `autoTranslationConfig`
- `ai`
- `googleAnalytics`
- `expertise`
- `email`

Passing an unsupported field name results in a `400` validation error response.

oneOf.description:
Use `minimal` to get only identifiers and legal links.
Use `all` to get the full configuration.

Comma separated list of top-level configuration field names. Allowed values:
`appName`, `termsOfService`, `privacyPolicy`, `languages`, `autoGovernance`,
`people`, `autoTranslationConfig`, `ai`, `googleAnalytics`, `expertise`, `email`.

post.summary: List people with search or filter
post.description:
You can filter by standard fields (like `department`, `division`, `title`) or custom fields  (ending with `__c`, like `team__c`).

Example request payload showing filter applied on a standard field (department) and a custom field (team__c): The query finds users in one of the two Marketing department teams.
```
{
  "pageSize": 10,
  "department": ["Marketing"],
  "team__c": ["Branding Brainiacs", "Ad-Vengers"]
}
```

sortOrder.description: Order in which to sort the results. Valid values are ASC (ascending) or DESC (descending).

pageSize.description: Number of items per page. Default value is 10.

pageToken.description: A cursor to use in pagination. Should be nextPageToken received in previous page response.

includeTotal.description: Whether to include the total user count in the response

get.description: Returns the set of people (profile) attributes available for the tenant, including standard and custom fields. Use optional query parameters to filter by attribute name and whether the field is filterable in the product.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: When set, return only the attribute whose external name matches (e.g. `firstName`, `department`, or a custom `field__c` name).

parameters.name: isFilterable
parameters.description: When `true` or `false`, filter to attributes that are or are not filterable.

get.summary: List distinct values for a filterable attribute
get.description:
Returns paginated distinct values observed in user/profile data for a **filterable** attribute (standard or custom). Used to populate filter choices (e.g. distinct departments, titles, or custom picklist-like usage backed by stored values).
Query parameters support optional text search over the value list. pagination via `nextPageToken` and `pageSize` (default page size 50).

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: External attribute name (`department`, `timezone`, custom `something__c`, etc.).

parameters.name: searchTerm
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring filter applied to candidate values.

parameters.name: nextPageToken
parameters.description: Opaque offset for the next page; use the value from the previous response when more items exist.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Page size (1–500). May be passed as a number or numeric string.

get.summary: List configured allowed values for an attribute
get.description:
Returns paginated **configured** allowed values from tenant field configuration (`tenant_fields.options`), for attributes that support an explicit option list: picklist, multi-select, or enum-style custom fields.
Values are sorted alphabetically (case-insensitive). The same pagination and optional `searchTerm` behavior applies as for distinct **values**.
Non-qualifying attribute types return a client error (invalid operation).

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: External attribute name (`firstName`, custom `color__c`, etc.).

parameters.name: searchTerm
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on the allowed value strings.

parameters.name: nextPageToken
parameters.description: Offset token for the next page from the previous response.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Page size (1–500), as number or numeric string.
